naslov: Los Angeles visits Phoenix, looks to end road skid
tekst:
Los Angeles Clippers (2-7, 13th in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (3-6, 12th in the Western Conference)
              Phoenix; Tuesday, 9 p.m. EST
              LINE: Suns -4.5; over/under is 226.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles will attempt to end its four-game road slide when the Clippers take on Phoenix.
              Phoenix went 45-37 overall, 10-7 in Pacific Division games and 25-16 at home a season ago. The Suns averaged 9.5 steals, 4.2 blocks and 13.5 turnovers per game last season.
              Los Angeles went 42-40 overall and 25-27 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 113.8 points per game last season, 49.4 in the paint, 18.5 off of turnovers and 13.7 on fast breaks.
              INJURIES: Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder), Jordan Goodwin: out (calf).
              Clippers: Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Cam Christie: day to day (ankle), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee).
